what: The kissing ledger: every public record configuration for the kissing number, re-decided in exact arithmetic over Z[sqrt2] on BigInt — shared-nothing with every producer's own verifier. A direction set with pairwise angles >= 60 degrees IS a kissing configuration; the decision is <x,y> <= 0 or 4<x,y>^2 <= <x,x><y,y>, exact, per pair.
scope: Lower-bound witnesses only. No upper-bound (SDP) claims are touched, and no search for new records is performed.
